name: or and with any left operand keeps the left value
source:
function f(v: any): void { console.log(v || 5); console.log(v && 5); console.log(v || "x"); console.log(v && "y"); console.log(v || {a: 1}); console.log(v || null); console.log(v || true); console.log(v && false); }
function main(): void { f("abc"); f(0); f(null); f(undefined); f(false); f(7); }
